basic_details.job_title: Salem City Health Society Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 30 Lab Technician, ANM and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: The City Health Society (Maanagara Nalavaazhvu Sangam) of Salem Corporation, under the Public Health and Preventive Medicine Department, is filling 30 purely temporary contract posts: 1 Lab Technician, 28 Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANM) and 1 Multi Purpose Hospital Worker. The consolidated pay ranges from Rs. 11,000 to Rs. 17,500 per month, and the qualification ranges from 8th Standard for the Multi Purpose Hospital Worker post to the 2-year ANM course and DMLT. Applications are accepted in person or by Speed Post at the City Health Society office in Kottai, Salem. The notice is dated 18 Novem

how_to_apply: Applications are made offline on the prescribed form. The form is printed in Tamil on pages 2 and 3 of the notice and can also be downloaded from the Salem Corporation website.
Download the application form from the website www.salemcorporation.gov.in.
Write the name of the post you are applying for at the top of the form.

Fill in your name, the post applied for, your father's or husband's name, your date of birth and age, your educational qualification, your community certificate details, your Aadhaar number, your mobile number and email (if any), any previous experience, and your temporary and permanent addresses.
Paste a passport size photo on the application, and write your full address and phone number.
Sign the form and write the place and the date.
Attach self-attested copies of your certificates (see the list below).
Hand in the application in person, or send it by Speed Post, to: Executive Secretary / City Health Officer, City Health Society, Navalar Nedunchezhiyan Salai, Kottai, Salem – 636001.
Passport size photo pasted on the application
Self-attested copy of the educational qualification certificate (10th/12th/Degree certificate)
Self-attested copy of the additional qualification certificate
Self-attested copy of the experience certificate
Self-attested copy of the community certificate
Self-attested copies of ID proof and address proof

content_sections.heading: About Salem City Health Society
content_sections.text: The City Health Society functions under Salem Corporation in Tamil Nadu. The notice is printed under the Public Health and Preventive Medicine Department and carries the logo of the National Health Mission, Tamil Nadu. The recruitment notice refers to the letter of the Mission Director, National Health Mission, Chennai, Rc. No. 6882/NUHM/p13/2020 dated 12.06.2025. The society's office is on Navalar Nedunchezhiyan Salai, Kottai, Salem – 636001.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists 30 posts in total. It does not give a category-wise break-up. According to the notice, the number of posts is subject to change.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post has its own essential qualification. The notice prints the age as "Age Preference: Below 40 Years" for all three posts, so 40 years itself falls outside the preference. The notice does not give an "as on" date for age or any age relaxation. The notice does not ask for experience for any post. Applicants who have previous experience must attach a copy of the experience certificate to the application. Check the official notification for the full eligibility of each post.

rows.essential_qualification: 1) Must have passed +2 in a recognized school with science subject. 2) DMLT
2 Years ANM Course in Recognized Institution
Should have studied minimum 8th Standard. Must be able to read.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The pay for all three posts is a consolidated amount per month: Rs. 17,000/- for Lab Technician, Rs. 17,500/- for Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANM) and Rs. 11,000/- for Multi Purpose Hospital Worker. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of this pay. The following conditions apply to every post: The post is purely temporary. The job will not be made permanent (regularised) at any time. Selected candidates must submit a voluntary consent letter (Undertaking) for joining duty and an 11-month contract bond.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Salem City Health Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 30 posts: 1 Lab Technician, 28 Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANM) and 1 Multi Purpose Hospital Worker. The notice says the number of posts is subject to change.

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed +2 in a recognized school with a science subject and must also hold a DMLT.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the ANM post?
faq.answer: Candidates for Auxiliary Nurse Midwives (ANM) need a 2-year ANM course from a recognized institution.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Multi Purpose Hospital Worker post?
faq.answer: Candidates should have studied up to at least 8th Standard and must be able to read.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The notice gives an age preference of below 40 years for all three posts.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for the Salem City Health Society posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated pay per month is Rs. 17,000/- for Lab Technician, Rs. 17,500/- for ANM and Rs. 11,000/- for Multi Purpose Hospital Worker.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for Salem City Health Society Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Download the form from www.salemcorporation.gov.in, attach the self-attested certificates, and submit it in person or by Speed Post to the Executive Secretary / City Health Officer, City Health Society, Navalar Nedunchezhiyan Salai, Kottai, Salem – 636001.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The posts are purely temporary and on contract, and the notice states that the job will not be regularised at any time. Selected candidates must submit an Undertaking and an 11-month contract bond.
